teaches: A product that shapes the distributor's space: entity_config names the record set the space keys its entities on (one of THIS product's record_configs, never a bundle config), distributor_front_page_layouts installs front page layouts (only id and config_id are checked at publish; the body is the workspaces server's), and sla_business_days overrides the default of 2. None of it reaches an existing distributor until sync_distribution_products runs.
